modes: full, no_<group> for each feature group of the input, no_history (the measured past-day groups) and minimal (the time encodings), by selection.common.group
fit: the xgb step's final fit on the features a mode keeps: the searched parameters of the record, the seed, early stopping on the validation rows (D-10), constraints by exact name for the features left
score: nRMSE in kW (% of 3,449 kW) of the raw forecast on the scoring hours of the validation window; L-09 is not applied
delta: mode minus full of the same target, horizon and seed (pp)
verdict: helpful above, harmful below minus max(0.05 pp, 2 x the pooled seed std of the deltas); neutral otherwise
forecast_rows: daytime hours of each window; the test window only in a final run (forecast, logged, not scored in phase 1)
